design_system_overview.project_name: Anjana Sara Abraham — Executive Portfolio Refinement
design_system_overview.persona: E1 Creative Designer — Editorial Consulting & Strategy Aesthetic
design_system_overview.theme_mode: Soft Navy-Blue Charcoal (Lighter than near-black, high legibility, refined editorial tone)
design_system_overview.aesthetic_direction: High-end management consulting / business transformation editorial dossier. Combines the typographic authority of classic Swiss/editorial publications (Playfair Display + IBM Plex Sans) with modern tactical coordinate grids, crisp card step surfaces, and teal-lavender accents.
core_design_goals: Visibly lighten base background from heavy near-black (#090d16) to an airy, sophisticated soft navy-blue charcoal (#121929 / #131d31).
Establish distinct surface elevation steps (#19253d for cards, #152033 for section tints, #202f4b for active/hover states).
Increase header brand name typography from 10px to ~14px with refined letter-spacing and weight for executive presence.

Modestly compress oversized vertical section padding (from 100px/124px down to 68px-76px) and tame oversized clamp() headings (from 7rem down to 4rem-4.25rem) to reduce page scrolling friction while retaining editorial drama.
Strictly preserve all factual text, project URLs, PDF resume link, contact details, and plain uploaded portrait presentation.

surface_step_hierarchy.level_0_page_canvas: var(--bg) [#121929] — warm slate charcoal base replacing harsh black
surface_step_hierarchy.level_1_section_tint: var(--section-tint) [#152034] — alternate section backdrop for Experience, Skills, Achievements
surface_step_hierarchy.level_2_card_surface: var(--surface) [#19253d] — container background with 1px border var(--border)
surface_step_hierarchy.level_3_elevated_interactive: var(--surface-elevated) [#202f4d] — hovered cards, active pills, contact card accents
surface_step_hierarchy.level_4_overlay_header: var(--header-bg) [rgba(18, 25, 41, 0.94)] — sticky header with backdrop-filter blur(16px)

header_brand_name.rationale: Gives Anjana Sara Abraham's brand name clear executive prominence without overcrowding the header navigation items.

hero_h1_display.rationale: Maintains commanding editorial presence while cutting ~40% off oversized vertical height so hero copy, portrait, metrics, and CTA fit comfortably above the fold on desktop.

section_h2_headings.rationale: Prevents section titles from occupying multiple excessive vertical lines.

card_h3_headings.skills_h3: 17px (0.01em letter spacing, IBM Plex Sans 600 weight)

section_shell.rationale: Eliminates excessive empty vertical gaps between content sections, making the single-page dossier 25-30% more compact without feeling dense.

guidelines: Ensure header background is 'rgba(18, 25, 41, 0.94)' with backdrop-filter: blur(16px). NEVER transparent.
Set .brand-name font-size to 14px (0.875rem), font-weight: 600, color: var(--ink), letter-spacing: 0.12em.
Keep header height at 70px (compact from 76px).
Keep navigation items at 10.5px uppercase with hover transition to var(--accent).
Ensure data-testid='nav-brand-logo' and data-testid='main-header-nav' remain intact.
Portrait image (data-testid='profile-image'): MUST remain clean and plain with object-fit: cover, object-position: center 23%. DO NOT apply grayscale or blur filters.
Poster container (.portrait-poster): Keep 1px solid border (rgba(243, 232, 220, 0.45)), background: var(--surface).
Hero visual container (.hero-visual): Background #162137, 1px border rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.35), shadow: 16px 16px 0 rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.05).
Metric cards (.hero-metrics): Top border 1px solid var(--border), metrics numbers at clamp(1.65rem, 2.4vw, 2.4rem).
Resume and CTAs: Keep direct link to Anjana's PDF CV on Emergent CDN and '#projects' anchor button.
Background: rgba(21, 32, 52, 0.85) with top and bottom borders 1px solid var(--border).
Padding: 14px 0 (reduced from 20px) to feel sleek and non-intrusive.
Color: rgba(221, 214, 254, 0.85), font-size: 10.5px, letter-spacing: 0.2em.
Section structure with sticky left rail (01 / ABOUT) at 140px width.
Focus list items (Understand problem / Redesign process / Measure movement): Background rgba(25, 37, 61, 0.7), border 1px solid var(--soft-border), min-height: 90px.
Section background: var(--section-tint) [#152034].
Experience cards: Background var(--surface) [#19253d], border 1px solid var(--border). Hover state lifts -3px with border-color rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.5).
Preserve Zealogics IT Solutions and SFO Technologies content, metric pills (1,000+ parts, 25% faster resolution, 99% first-pass, 20+ workforce).
Maintain 2-column grid for Musafir and SPMS, full-width banner for Bayer (Ongoing Live Project).
Live card styling (.project-card-live): Gradient background linear-gradient(115deg, #1b2d4b 0%, #17243c 60%, #1e2c46 100%), border-color rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.55).
Flow diagrams: Background rgba(18, 25, 41, 0.45), 1px border rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.22).
Keep project URLs active: Musafir (https://india-tourism-insights.ananya-pgpm27g.chatgpt.site/) and SPMS (https://anjanasaraabraham.github.io/SPMSProjectFinal/).
3-column layout on desktop, 2-column on tablet, 1-column on mobile.
Skill panel background: var(--surface) [#19253d], border: 1px solid var(--border).
Skill tag pills: Background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), color #d1d9e6.
Maintain clean ledger tabular aesthetics with border-bottom dividers.
Ledger row degrees in Playfair Display (var(--lavender)), schools in IBM Plex Sans, years/percentages in uppercase teal (var(--accent)).
Contact section background: #152033 (soft navy charcoal).
Contact card background: #19253d with teal glow border (rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.42)) and offset box-shadow 12px 12px 0 rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.06).
Footer background: #0e1422, padding 22px 7vw, border-top 1px solid var(--border).

breakpoints.desktop_wide: 1500px max container width (width: min(100%, 1500px); margin: 0 auto;)
breakpoints.tablet_landscape: max-width: 1180px — reduce padding to 5vw, desktop nav gap to 14px
breakpoints.tablet_portrait: max-width: 960px — switch to mobile menu drawer, single column hero, 2-col skills
breakpoints.mobile: max-width: 680px — stack rails inline, single column projects, 48px vertical section padding
breakpoints.small_mobile: max-width: 420px — hero heading clamp floor 2.1rem, brand-name text wrapped smoothly

critical_safeguards: Header text collision: brand-name set to white-space: nowrap with overflow ellipsis or flex-shrink-0.
No horizontal scroll: html overflow-x: hidden; body overflow-x: clip;
Touch targets: all nav links, buttons, and contact items have min-height 42px - 46px.
Contrast compliance: all body text has minimum 5.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast against soft navy charcoal #121929.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.do_not_write_generic_code: Preserve the bespoke editorial identity of the portfolio. Avoid turning it into generic blue corporate templates.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.preserve_all_content: Do NOT alter or remove any biographical facts, metrics, education records, achievements, or external links.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.keep_portrait_unaltered: The portrait image at URL 'https://customer-assets-m6fa6gv7.emergentagent.net/job_anjana-insights/artifacts/4vgqy68z_WhatsApp%20Image%202026-08-04%20at%2012.54.06%20AM%20%281%29.webp' MUST remain plain and unedited.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Ensure soft navy charcoal (#121929) replaces old pitch navy (#090d16). Ensure surface contrast is crisp (#19253d cards, #152034 section tints).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_typography: Brand name must be ~14px with font-weight 600.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_discipline: Section shell padding reduced from 100px to ~68px-72px; contact padding reduced from 124px to ~76px-80px; hero heading clamp reduced from 7rem to ~4.25rem.
